query: MiniMaxH3MemoryEfficientSageAttentionPatch fails with 'sageattention is not new enough version or could not determine CUDA architecture' despite correct torch 2.13+cu130 / sageattention 2.2.0 - node's own version/arch check bug.

desired.outcome: Workaround confirmed by OP (C5) and others: swap the node for 'Patch Sage Attention KJ' (aakash-chaddha, C2) - after which the native H3 patch also started working again for some. Real fix tracked in PR #15270 (still open at thread end).
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause class; proposed fix is actionable and directionally correct for this workflow.
